title: Sulaymaniyah — Halabja & Amna Suraka
full_text:
Morning tour of Mawlawi's market, where we will get to try some local restaurants and see its famous Langa (thrift) market.
Head to Halabja — a city that faced a genocide by the former regime, yet is still there and thriving. We will get to see its local markets and the famous memorial.
Head back to Sulaymaniyah and visit Amna Suraka, the "Red Museum", which documents some of the atrocities committed during the past regime.
Later in the evening, visit Salim Street — a street bustling with local food carts and shops.
